purpose: Author-written gallery scenarios; no random or hand-approximated geometry. GPU not run.
retrieval: Read-only SELECT Operation.data ORDER BY seq via existing scripts/strokes/app.py access; no DB writes. Full room logs not persisted.
selectionRule: Visible watercolor gestures, contiguous chunks grouped by user/layer/stroke; median dab XY inside archived slot as scripts/strokes/carrier_all.py:select_slots. Preserve all selected multi-gesture water/pigment history.
replayQualification: Recorded author operations belong to historical room geometry/preset/model. Exact replay on 1024 needs an explicit coordinate/size/paper-world policy, not a silent fit. No claim that transformed replay equals the original room pixels. Sheet notes describe photographs; preset bytes are authoritative for app input. Selected slot is a scenario, not necessarily one gesture: water preparation and subsequent pigment/water drop must remain ordered. Whole-room paper_dry/clear/undo replay is not included; this manifest selects current visible strokes, not a replacement for app_render full-log semantics.
